ending.title: A DIRECTION AND A QUESTION
ending.text: Blackthorn Station. Midnight tomorrow. Armand has a direction, but not the name or purpose of whoever took Callum.

rooms.name: Outside Callum's House
rooms.overview: Rain falls over a dark house. Wheel ruts cross the mud; a front window, mailbox, locked front door, broken gate, covered woodpile, and paths around either side remain within reach.
ambient: Rain ticks against the dark front window.
Wet leaves stir beside the house.
rooms.guillermo: Guillermo can reach into the mailbox, but at his Early communication tier Armand must inspect whatever he retrieves.

mundane.front_door: The front door is firmly locked; forcing it would make enough noise to announce Armand's arrival.
mundane.broken_gate: The gate latch has been broken for years.
mundane.woodpile: The firewood remains dry beneath its tarpaulin.
mundane.kitchen_path: The path continues around the house toward a kitchen door.
mundane.cellar_path: The ruts and wet ground continue toward an outer cellar door.

rooms.name: Cellar
rooms.overview: An ajar outer door opens onto an unlit cellar: an earth floor, sweating stone walls, preserve shelves, wine bottles, sprouting potatoes, a broken chair, and a coil of rope beside the stair.
ambient: The cellar is notably silent; even the rain disappears down here.
Footsteps on the floor above carry clearly through the joists.
rooms.guillermo: Guillermo can scout the shelf tops and dark gaps, then gesture for Armand to inspect the place himself.
objects: coil of rope on a hook

mundane.earth_floor: The packed earth holds old scuffs but no distinct fresh print.
mundane.stone_walls: Moisture beads on the stone without marking a hidden opening.
mundane.preserve_shelves: The jars are dated in a woman's hand from before Callum's tenancy.
mundane.wine_bottles: Most bottles are empty and their labels are illegible.
mundane.potato_sack: The potatoes have sprouted pale shoots.
mundane.broken_chair: The chair failed from age, not violence.

variants.text: The coarse hemp matches the fibres Armand observed upstairs, though this coil itself is intact.
Coarse hemp lies tightly coiled, with dust settled into its lay; nothing has been cut from it.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.overview: Rotting food and standing green water sour the kitchen. A half-prepared meal sits on the stove beside a knife block; dishes, a dry cloth, pantry shelves, tea tin, dusty cat dish, and bolted back door remain.
ambient: The smell of woodsmoke drifts in from deeper in the house.
rooms.guillermo: Guillermo can reach the high pantry shelf and draw Armand's attention to the preserves, but cannot explain what he sees.

mundane.sink_dishes: The water has gone green around dishes left for many days.
mundane.dishcloth: The cloth is stiff and completely dry.
mundane.pantry: Flour, salt, and preserves remain on the pantry shelves.
mundane.tea_tin: The ordinary tea tin is half full.
mundane.cat_dish: The cat dish is empty and dusty; no cat is present.
mundane.kitchen_window: Only a few sluggish flies remain at the glass.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.overview: Books lie face-down before a disturbed bookcase and cold hearth. Two teacups, a pipe rack, dusty chess game, straight river print, empty decanter, clean glass, and pulled-back rug occupy the displaced room.
ambient: Rain whispers against the living-room glass.
Wind moves through the cold chimney while smoke smells stronger toward the study.
rooms.guillermo: Guillermo can climb behind the bookcase and indicate the high shelf gap; Armand must come examine it.

mundane.living_hearth: The hearth is cold and has not held a recent fire.
mundane.pipe_rack: Three pipes rest in the rack; one was smoked more recently than the others.
mundane.chess_set: Dust lies over both sides of the unfinished game.
mundane.river_print: The river print hangs straight, unusually undisturbed.
mundane.decanter: The decanter is empty and the single glass is clean.
mundane.pulled_rug: One corner exposes ordinary bare boards.

rooms.name: Bedroom
rooms.overview: The searched bedroom has open drawers, scattered clothes, a made bed, open closet, packed suitcase, face-down photograph, opened boxes, wardrobe, bedside novel, dry wash-stand, polished shoes, and drawn curtains.
ambient: Rain is muffled by the drawn curtains.
An upstairs floorboard settles somewhere beyond the room.
rooms.guillermo: Guillermo can slip under the bed behind the boxes and point out what Armand should pull into the light.

mundane.bedroom_drawers: The drawers were pulled out and searched without care.
mundane.clothes: The clothes are ordinary and worn at the cuffs.
mundane.made_bed: The bed was made before the disorder began.
mundane.bedside_novel: A ribbon marks the novel roughly one-third through.
mundane.washstand: The jug's water evaporated long ago.
mundane.shoes: The good shoes beneath the bed remain polished.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.overview: Cold tile encloses a small bathroom. A shattered mirror hangs above the basin beside toiletries, a dripping tap, dry towel, medicine cabinet, cracked soap, and a window too small for a person.
ambient: The tap drips with mechanical patience.
Rain beads on the bathroom's small window.
rooms.guillermo: Guillermo can climb to the medicine cabinet and point; Armand still has to inspect its contents.

mundane.dripping_tap: The tap continues to drip; nothing is concealed in the basin.
mundane.dry_towel: The towel is dry and stiff with age.
mundane.medicine_cabinet: Tooth powder, headache tincture, and a spare razor blade remain.
mundane.cracked_soap: The soap cracked as it dried.
mundane.small_window: The window is far too small for a person to use.
mundane.cold_tile: Mildew gathers in the tile corners.

rooms.name: Callum's Study
rooms.overview: A dark stain marks the floor near a scratched writing desk. Papers, a cold scorched hearth, fire-irons, oil lamp, disturbed shelves, wastebasket, desk calendar, framed front page, heavy painting, chair, rug, window, and paneled wall fill the room.
ambient: Wind breathes through the chimney; the impossible woodsmoke smell is strongest here.
rooms.guillermo: Guillermo can climb the paintings or work the safe dial slowly while Armand listens and investigates.

clues.name: Accumulated mail
tiers: The delivery dates show Callum stopped collecting mail eleven days ago.
The final delivered letter arrived after the earlier threatening correspondence.

clues.name: Cart tracks
tiers: A cart or small carriage stood here.
It stood long enough for the horses to shift and stamp.
The ruts are deeper leaving than arriving.

clues.name: Window smudges
tiers: Someone stood close and looked in.
Several smears lie on the outside of the glass.

clues.name: Forced cellar door
tiers: The frame is splintered near the latch.
It was forced from outside recently; the splinters are pale.
It was forced twice; older weathered-grey damage lies underneath.

clues.name: Abandoned meal
tiers: The food has long gone bad.
It has stood between one and two weeks.
That age matches the date of the last delivered letter.

clues.name: Missing kitchen knife
tiers: It is absent from the sink, drawers, and drying rack.

clues.name: Inside door bolt
tiers: The back-door bolt is drawn from inside.

clues.name: Two used teacups
tiers: One holds a long-dried ring; the other was barely touched.
The barely touched cup was set down in a hurry and slopped unwiped.

clues.name: Disturbed shelf gap
tiers: The volumes were pulled and dropped, not browsed.
They are histories and works of occult lore.
The searchers wanted information, not valuables.
The gap fits a volume on binding rites absent from the fallen books.

clues.name: Margaret photograph
tiers: The photograph shows a woman on a station platform.
Callum's byline first appeared in print that month.

clues.name: Packed suitcase
tiers: The suitcase is packed and fastened.
It was packed carefully for several days away.
Dust on the handle shows it has stood here longer than a day.

clues.name: Opened archive boxes
tiers: The boxes hold old papers, clippings, and correspondence.
Callum kept his own published work in order.
One emptied folder bears a half-torn place name: Blackthorn.

clues.name: Travel toiletries left behind
tiers: Shaving kit, razor, and brush are all present.
Nothing a traveller would normally take is missing.

clues.name: Broken bathroom mirror
tiers: A single blow near the centre shattered it.
No shards were cleared; the rest of the room is undamaged.
The fracture radiates from a point inside the glass.

clues.name: Framed first article
tiers: Callum's first published piece is dated 08/10/83.

clues.name: Emptied wastebasket
tiers: One discarded scrap is charred at the corner.

clues.name: Outdated desk calendar
tiers: The last marked day is eleven days ago.
That day carries one word: Blackthorn.
